tiptap_body.circle_ios_fallback_text: Hi everyone! I’m Yujin Lee. I’m an expat from Korea (South Korea, of course! Haha) and I’ve been running my digital marketing agency, LABELESS, here in Hong Kong for over six years.We handle digital transformation, covering everything from branding and web design to lead gen and content. Right now, my goal is to free myself from the daily office grind so I can work on my business, not just in it.I’ve been interested in AI since day one—we even had our own AI content platform before ChatGPT was a thing! That said, I’m a Visionary founder, not a developer. I haven't found my Integrator yet (referencing the book Traction), but that is the next step in my journey.
